blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Questions about long egocentric video often depend on one brief moment, such as the second a hand puts an object down. A vision-language model (VLM) that sees a few evenly spaced frames usually misses it. Training-free methods rank frames with a separate image-text model or ask the VLM to write a time. In a controlled test, the VLM itself locates the moment better when it chooses among labeled frames, and we read this choice from its output distribution. With the same candidates, this choice lands on the evidence more often than image-text scores or a written time span, and it compares all candidates in one decision. Based on this finding, we propose EgoJev, a training-free frame selector for wearable assistants. EgoJev reads where the evidence is from labeled thumbnails and looks again at the windows it points to. It places its few answer frames at the quantiles of the resulting distribution. One frozen VLM selects, answers and returns the evidence time, with no second model. A wearable device can encode its coarse thumbnails while it records. With Qwen3.5-4B and 8 answer frames, EgoJev raises QAEgo4D accuracy from 51.2% with uniform sampling to 62.0%, and it outperforms recent training-free frame selectors on QAEgo4D and MyEgo. A single-level version runs on a Mac and an iPhone.
blocks.zh: 关于长长的以自我为中心的视频的问题常常取决于一个短暂的时刻,比如第二只手把物体放下. 一个视觉语言模型(VLM),它看到一些均匀的空间框架通常会错过它. 无训练方法用单独的图像文本模型排序帧,或者要求VLM写一个时间. 在受控测试中,VLM本身在选择标有标签的帧时定位得更好,我们从其输出分布中读取这个选择. 与同一批候选人相比,这种选择往往比图像文本得分或书面时间跨度更常见于证据上,它在一个决定中对所有候选人进行比较。 基于这一发现,我们提议EgoJev,一个可供佩戴的助手的免训练框架选择器. 叶子 Jev读到标注在缩略图中的证据位置, 它将其为数不多的答案框放在所产生的分布的四分位数上。 一个被冻结的VLM选择,回答和返回证据时间,没有第二个模型. 可穿戴的设备可以在记录时编码其粗糙的缩略图. 用Quen3.5-4B和8个答框,EgoJev将QAEGO4D精度由51.2%统一采样提升到62.0%,在QAEGO4D和MyEGO上它的表现超过了最近的无训练帧选择器. 单层版本运行在Mac和iPhone上.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Smart glasses can record what their wearer sees and later answer questions about it, such as “Where did I put the scissors?” or “What did I take out of the fridge?” [ 11 , 5 ] .
Such an assistant works under three limits.
First, it can afford only a few frames per question. The device has little compute, and sending video to a server costs bandwidth and privacy.
Second, a single small model must do the work, since a second network that watches every frame adds memory and power.
Third, the answer should come with the moment it was taken from, because a user who asks about the past wants to see that moment.
blocks.zh:
聪明的眼镜可以记录穿戴者所看到的东西,然后回答有关问题,例如“我把剪刀放哪里了?” 或“我从冰箱里拿了什么?” [11、5]。
这种助理在三个限度内工作。
首先,每个问题只能承受几个帧。 该设备几乎没有计算,向服务器发送视频会花费带宽和隐私.
其次,一个单一的小型模型必须完成这项工作,因为第二个监视每个帧的网络会增加内存和力量.
第三,答案应该随时间而来,因为询问过去情况的用户希望看到这一时刻。

blocks.en:
Training-free methods choose better frames in three ways, and none fits these limits well.
Similarity-based selectors [ 25 , 17 ] score every frame with a separate image-text model such as CLIP [ 21 ] or BLIP [ 14 ] .
They need that second model, and they only compare frames with the question text.
A second way asks the VLM to rate each frame on its own, for example by the probability of “Yes” [ 34 ] .
This needs one forward pass per frame, and frames scored in separate calls are never compared.
The third way asks the VLM to write when the evidence appears, as a time span or as frame IDs [ 2 ] .
The spans it writes land on the evidence less often.
blocks.zh:
无培训方法从三个方面选择更好的框架,没有一种方法完全符合这些限制。
基于相似性的选手[25,17]每帧得分,分别使用CLIP[21]或BLIP[14]等图像文本模型.
他们需要第二个模型,他们只比较框架和问题文本。
另一种方式是要求VLM自行对每个框架进行评分,例如按“是”的概率进行评分[34]。
这需要每帧一个前传,在单独呼叫中得分的帧从不进行比较.
第三种方式要求VLM在证据出现时,作为时间跨度或帧ID[2]写作.
它在证据上写的长度 较少。

blocks.en:
Our idea is to let the VLM choose and to read its choice from the output probabilities ( Fig. 1 ).
The VLM sees the candidate frames as separate images, each after a number label such as “Segment 3:”, and is asked where the answer is.
One forward pass then gives the probability of each label.
This treats the VLM as a decision model that returns a probability for each option, as in Jev [ 1 ] .
Based on this idea, we propose EgoJev, a training-free frame selector for wearable assistants.
EgoJev finds the evidence in two steps.
It first reads one small labeled thumbnail per video segment.
Brief evidence often falls between two thumbnails, so it then reads again inside the windows with the most probability and combines the two levels.
It then places the answer frames at the quantiles of this distribution, so they gather when the model is sure and spread when it is not.
The same VLM answers from these frames, and one more readout returns the evidence time.
Unlike per-frame rating [ 34 ] or similarity selectors [ 25 , 17 ] , EgoJev compares all candidates in one decision. Unlike ID writing [ 2 ] , it reads this decision as a distribution and generates no text.
One frozen VLM thus selects, answers and points to its evidence, with no second model.
EgoJev is also plug-and-play, since it needs only the output probabilities of the VLM that answers.
Because the thumbnails come before the question, a wearable device can encode them while it records.
blocks.zh:
我们的想法是让VLM选择并从输出概率(图1)读取其选择.
VLM将候选框架视为单独的图像,每个图像都放在“第3段”等数字标签之后,并被问到答案在哪里。
一个前传,然后给出每个标签的概率.
这把VLM作为返回每个选项概率的决定模型,如Jev [1].
基于这个想法,我们提议EgoJev,一个可供穿戴的助手的免费框架选择器.
EgoJev分两步找到证据。
它首先读到每个视频段一个小标注的缩略图.
简短的证据往往落在两个缩略图之间,因此它再在窗口内以最概率读取,并结合两个级别.
然后将答案框放在这个分布的四分位数上,所以当模型确定时它们会聚集,当模型不确定时它们会扩散.

blocks.en:
We evaluate EgoJev on three egocentric benchmarks with four VLMs from three families.
On the same candidates, reading the choice finds the evidence more often than rating frames, writing spans or scoring with BLIP and CLIP.
It also works much better with labeled images than with one video.
Its lead is largest on evidence shorter than 3 s, the kind of moment that egocentric questions ask about.

贴上标签的图像也比一个视频好得多。
在短于3秒的证据上,它的领先性最大, 那种以自我为中心的问题问起的时刻。

It reads the VLM’s decision from coarse to fine and places the answer frames at its quantiles. One frozen VLM selects, answers and returns the evidence time, with no second model. Its thumbnails can be encoded during recording. • With Qwen3.5-4B, EgoJev raises QAEgo4D accuracy from 51.2% to 62.0% and outperforms recent training-free frame selectors on QAEgo4D and MyEgo. blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
A VLM can read only a few frames of a long video, so many training-free methods decide which frames to show it.
Most of them score frames by image-text similarity.
AKS [ 25 ] balances relevance and coverage with BLIP [ 14 ] scores.
BOLT [ 17 ] samples frames in proportion to sharpened CLIP scores, with a sharpness tuned per benchmark.
Others add multi-resolution inputs [ 37 ] , bandit search [ 40 ] , answer options [ 30 ] , or scene changes [ 8 ] .
These methods run a second embedding model over every candidate frame.
Other methods read attention maps inside a second, smaller MLLM whose layer and budget are tuned on held-out videos [ 27 ] or let an LLM pick frames from generated captions [ 26 , 28 , 36 ] .
EcoFrame [ 15 ] reads the attention and output entropy of the answering VLM to decide when to add frames, and still scores relevance with CLIP.
A few methods let a VLM guide the search.
T* [ 33 ] searches grids of frames with an object detector, and A.I.R. [ 41 ] scores frames at 1 fps with CLIP and then has a VLM write a score for each candidate, for up to six rounds.
EgoJev targets egocentric questions whose evidence is brief. In contrast to these methods, it needs no second model and generates no text: the answering VLM sees all candidates in one prompt, and we read one distribution over them.
blocks.zh:
一个VLM只能读取长视频的几帧,所以许多没有训练的方法决定要显示哪个帧.
多数都是通过图像文本的相似性来评分帧.
AKS[25]在相关性和覆盖范围与BLIP[14]分之间保持平衡.
BOLT [17] 标本框与锐化的CLIP分数成比例,每个基准的锐度调节.
另一些则添加多分辨率输入[37],强盗搜索[40],回答选项[30],或场景变化[8].
这些方法在每一个候选框架上运行第二个嵌入模型.
其他方法读取第二小的MLLM内部的注意图,其图层和预算被调用被搁置的视频[27]或让LLM从生成的字幕中选择帧[26,28,36].
EcoFrame [15] 读取解答 VLM 的注意度和输出均匀度,以决定何时添加帧,仍与 CLIP 进行相关评分.
少数方法让一个VLM指导搜索.
T*[33]用物体探测器搜索帧的网格,A.I.R.[41]用CLIP在1fps的计分帧,然后每个考生都有VLM写分,最多6轮.
EgoJev以自我为中心的问题为目标,其证据很简短。 与这些方法不同,它不需要第二个模型,也不会产生文字:解答的VLM会迅速看到所有候选者,我们阅读了它们上的一个分布.

blocks.en:
Egocentric benchmarks ask about brief past moments [ 11 , 5 ] or about whole clips [ 18 ] .
The first kind rewards finding the moment, and its evidence annotations let us measure localization directly.
MyEgo [ 31 ] asks about the camera wearer and marks the answer moment.
Video LLMs can be trained to write timestamps [ 23 , 12 ] , and GroundVQA [ 7 ] trains a model to answer and ground egocentric questions together.
NumPro [ 29 ] draws frame numbers on the frames so that a model can write the number of the relevant frame, and TimeMarker [ 6 ] interleaves time tokens with frames during training.
TCoT [ 2 ] shows the VLM segments of 64 frames with IDs and has it write the IDs of the relevant ones, one call per segment.
These methods output time or frame IDs as generated text, and most need training.
EgoJev is training-free and reads the evidence time from label probabilities.
blocks.zh:
Egocent基准询问过去短暂的时刻[11,5]或整个片段[18].
第一种奖励是找到时机,它的证据说明让我们直接衡量本地化。
MyEgo [31] 问起摄影机穿戴者,并标出答案时刻.
Video LLMS可以被训练写时间戳[23,12],GroundVQA[7]训练一个模型一起回答和地面自我中心问题.
NumPro [29] 在帧上绘制帧数,以便一个模型能够写入相关帧数,而TimeMark [6] 在训练期间将时间符与帧进行互换.
TCOT [2] 显示64帧的VLM片段带有ID,并让它写下相关片段的ID,每个片段一个呼叫.
这些方法输出时间或框架ID作为生成的文本,大多数需要培训.
EgoJev没有训练,从标签概率读取证据时间。

blocks.en:
Reading a choice from label probabilities is an old way to use a language model as a classifier [ 38 ] .
Jev [ 1 ] recently framed it as a decision model that returns a probability for each option in one forward pass, and open frozen LLMs match it without training [ 9 , 16 ] .
Label wording strongly shapes these decisions [ 3 ] .
Listwise rerankers write an order of passage IDs [ 24 ] , and FIRST [ 22 ] reads the ranking from the logits of the first output token.
For video, SeViLA [ 34 ] scores each frame by the probability of “Yes” to whether it helps answer the question, and UG-Sample [ 13 ] by the entropy of the answering MLLM’s output given that frame.
Each frame is then scored in its own forward pass and is never compared with the others.
We read one decision over all candidate images and use its whole distribution to place the frame budget.
One VLM thus makes three decisions: where the evidence is, what the answer is, and when it was seen.
blocks.zh:
从标签概率中读取一个选择,是一种使用语言模型作为分类器的老方法[38].
Jev [1] 最近把它设定为一种决定模式,在一次前传中返回每个选项的概率,并打开冷冻的LLMs在不经过训练的情况下匹配[9,16].
标签措辞对这些决定形成强烈影响 [3].
Listwise rerankers写下一个通过ID的顺序[24],FIRST [22]从第一个输出符的日志读取了排名.
对于视频,SeVilA [34] 将每个帧的概率评为“是”是否有助于回答问题,而UG-Sample [13] 则评为回答MLLM的输出的Entropy。
每帧在自己的前传中得分,从不与其他帧相比.
我们阅读了一项关于所有候选图像的一项决定,并用其整个分布来安排框架预算。
因此,一个VLM作出三个决定:证据在哪里,答案是什么,何时看到。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Our goal is to answer a multiple-choice question about a long egocentric video with a frozen vision-language model (VLM), a fixed frame budget, and no training.
The answer usually depends on a short moment, while uniform sampling spends most of the budget elsewhere.
EgoJev asks one VLM for three decisions and reads each one from its output probabilities: where the evidence is ( Sec. 3.2 ), what the answer is ( Sec. 3.3 ), and when the evidence was seen ( Sec. 3.4 ), as shown in Fig. 2 .
The key step is the first one: its probabilities, used as a whole distribution, decide where the frame budget goes.
One distribution drives every later step: it chooses which windows to look at again, decides how many answer frames go where, and these frames are read once more for the evidence time.
blocks.zh:
我们的目标是回答一个多选择的问题, 一个长长的自我中心视频,
答案通常取决于短暂的时刻,而统一的采样则将大部分预算花在其他地方.
EgoJev要求一个VLM作出三项裁决,并从其输出概率中逐一读出:证据在哪里(第3.2条)、答案是什么(第3.3条),以及证据何时被看到(第3.4条),如图2所示。
关键步骤是第一个步骤:其概率,作为整体分配使用,决定框架预算走向何方.
一次发行会逐次推动:它选择哪个窗口可以再次查看,决定有多少个答案框到哪里去,这些框会被再次读取作为证据的时间.

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题设置

blocks.en:
A video V V comes with a question q q and options O = { o 1 , … , o K } O=\{o_{1},\dots,o_{K}\} .
The VLM can see only B B frames, far fewer than the video has, and by default they are sampled uniformly.
A vision encoder and a projector turn each frame into visual tokens, and the language model with parameters θ \theta reads them with the text as one input X X .
With a fixed budget B B , the answer depends on which frames are selected.
Similarity-based methods [ 25 , 17 ] score each frame by its cosine similarity to the question in a separate image-text model, and generation-based methods ask the VLM to write a time or a frame ID.
EgoJev scores the frames with the output probabilities of the VLM that answers.

Because the model sees all candidates before it answers, it can compare them.
Methods that rate each frame on its own, such as SeViLA [ 34 ] , score the frames in separate calls, so the frames are never compared and their scores need not share a scale.

The frames must enter as separate labeled images: a video encoder may merge neighboring frames, and then a single frame has no label to choose ( Sec. 4.4 ).

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en:
All three benchmarks are egocentric and multiple choice, which matches the wearable setting.
QAEgo4D [ 5 ] asks about objects and actions in Ego4D [ 11 ] videos of about 8 minutes and marks the time window of the evidence.
Its multiple-choice test set, as released by GroundVQA [ 7 ] , has 500 questions over 148 videos.
MyEgo [ 31 ] asks about moments long before the question and marks the answer moment.
The evaluation uses all 996 of its questions asked at least 15 s after that moment, and the model sees the video only up to the question.
EgoSchema [ 18 ] asks about whole 3-minute clips and has no evidence annotation.
The evaluation uses its public subset of 500 questions.
blocks.zh:
这三项基准都以自我为中心,而且有多重选择,这与可穿戴的设定相吻合。
QAEgo4D [5] 问到Ego4D[11]视频中的物体和行动,时间约为8分钟,并标注了证据的时间窗口.
其多选择测试集,由GroundVQA[7]发布,有超过148个视频的500个问题.
MyEgo[31]很早就问了这个问题,并标志着答案的时刻。
评估使用其至少15秒后问到的所有996个问题,模型只看到视频直到问题.
Egoschema [18] 问起整个3分钟的剪辑,没有证据注释.
评价使用其500个问题的公共子集。

blocks.en:
Uniform samples B B frames evenly, including the first and last frame. AKS [ 25 ] scores every frame at 1 fps with BLIP and balances relevance and coverage. BOLT [ 17 ] scores every frame at 1 fps with CLIP and samples frames in proportion to the sharpened scores. A.I.R. [ 41 ] filters frames with CLIP and lets the VLM rate them over up to six rounds. FOCUS [ 40 ] searches clips as bandit arms with BLIP scores. Write IDs lets the same VLM write the labels of the relevant thumbnails among the 32 that EgoJev reads first, as TCoT [ 2 ] does, with up to 256 generated tokens.
Each written label places a frame in its segment, and evenly spaced frames fill the rest of the 8.
AKS, BOLT, A.I.R. and FOCUS run with their official code, settings and queries.
blocks.zh:
统一样品B B帧均匀,包括第一帧和最后一帧. AKS [25] 以1 fps的BLIP评分每个帧,平衡相关性和覆盖范围. BOLT [17] 每个帧的分数为1 fps,带有CLIP和样品帧与磨度分数的比例. A.I.R.[41]用CLIP过滤帧,让VLM评分超过6发. FOCUS [40] 搜索片段作为强盗手臂,BLIP得分. 写ID让相同的VLM将相关缩略图的标签写在EgoJev首先读的32个中,就像TCoT[2]所做的那样,最多有256个生成的令牌.
每个书面标签都在其片段中放置一个框,均衡的间距框填充其余的8个.
AKS,BOLT,A.I.R.和FOCUS使用他们的官方代码,设置和查询运行.

blocks.en: Accuracy is the share of correct answers. For localization, a hit means that the top segment overlaps the evidence, and a time counts as correct within 8 s of the evidence.
blocks.zh: 准确性是正确答案的比例。 对于本地化,一个命中意味着顶部部分与证据重叠,一个时间计算在证据的8s之内是正确的.

blocks.en:
The main VLM is Qwen3.5-4B [ 20 ] , kept frozen, and the same VLM answers for every method.
Every method answers from B = 8 B=8 labeled frames with the same cap on visual tokens per frame: 384 on QAEgo4D, 88 on EgoSchema and 72 on MyEgo.
Apart from these shared caps, every method keeps its own settings fixed across datasets and models.
Time is the mean end-to-end time per question over 50 QAEgo4D questions on one A100 MIG slice, including frame scoring.
EgoJev uses N = 32 N=32 thumbnails, W = 4 W=4 windows, k = 3 k=3 refined windows and τ = 1 \tau=1 .

VLMs can favor some option labels whatever the content [ 39 ] .
When a short test on 40 questions shows that the coarse readout follows the label numbers, it is also read in reverse order and the two are combined by their geometric mean, as in permutation debiasing [ 39 ] . We call this the label check.
With all four VLMs this fires only on EgoSchema.
AKS uses its official candidates and default thresholds, and BOLT, which has no setting for QAEgo4D or MyEgo, uses α = 2.5 \alpha=2.5 , its setting for EgoSchema.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Tab. 1 compares choosing with the answering VLM against choosing with a separate scorer.
EgoJev is the most accurate on QAEgo4D and MyEgo (62.0% and 42.6%).
It is also 3.1 times faster per question than A.I.R., which uses a second model.
On EgoSchema, which asks about whole clips, every selector that uses a second model falls below uniform sampling, while EgoJev with the label check matches it.
Given the same 32 thumbnails, AKS, BOLT and Write IDs all stay below single-level EgoJev on all three datasets ( Tab. 2 ).
Reading the choice thus beats both similarity scores and written IDs.
Without options in its prompt, EgoJev still leads AKS and BOLT ( Tab. 2 ), and options do not help AKS or BOLT on QAEgo4D (56.0% and 52.6%, Appendix D ).
EgoJev also puts an answer frame within 8 s of the evidence for 67.2% of QAEgo4D and 66.7% of MyEgo questions, against at most 59.2% and 58.0% for the baselines. Its lead over the best baseline is largest when the evidence lasts less than 3 s (62.6% against 58.0%, Tab. 14 ).
blocks.zh:
Tab. 1 比较了选择与答案的 VLM 而不是选择与单独的计分器.
EgoJev在QAEgo4D和MyEgo上最准确(62.0%和42.6%).
每个问题也比使用第二个模型的A.I.R.快3.1倍.
在询问整段剪辑的EgoSchema上,每个使用第二个模型的选手都低于统一的采样,而带有标签检查的EgoJev则与之匹配.
鉴于相同的32个缩略图,AKS,BOLT和Write ID在所有3个数据集(Tab. 2 )上都处于单级EgoJev以下.
阅读选择会比相似性分数和书面ID都要好。
EgoJev仍然领先AKS和BOLT(Tab. 2 ),
EgoJev还在证据的8s内给出了QAEGO4D的67.2%和MyEGO问题的66.7%的答案框架,而基准的回答率最多为59.2%和58.0%. 当证据持续时间不到3秒(62.6%对58.0%,Tab.14)时,其最佳基线的领先性最大。

blocks.en:
To test whether the gains hold beyond one model, Tab. 3 runs uniform sampling, AKS, BOLT, Write IDs, FOCUS and EgoJev on VLMs from three families with the settings of Tab. 1 .

It is also higher than that of FOCUS and Write IDs with all three.
With Qwen3-VL-8B it is above AKS and BOLT on every dataset.

blocks.en: 4.4 How to ask the VLM where to look
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 如何问 VLM 看哪里

blocks.en:
Tab. 4 asks whether the way the VLM is asked changes how well it finds the evidence.
Only the question changes: the VLM chooses one of the candidate frames, rates each frame alone by the probability of “Yes”, or writes a time span.
A method finds the evidence when the segment it ranks first overlaps the evidence window.
The test uses 16 candidates, the middle frames of 16 equal segments.
Choosing finds the evidence segment in 28.0% of QAEgo4D and 18.5% of MyEgo questions.
Rating each frame alone finds it in 18.2% and 13.5%, and writing a span in 15.8% and 12.6%.
BLIP and CLIP, the scorers of AKS and BOLT, reach only 19.0% and 15.6% on QAEgo4D.
With the 32 candidates of EgoJev, the order is the same on QAEgo4D: 28.6% for choosing, against 21.0% for rating, 17.8% for a span, and 19.4% and 18.8% for BLIP and CLIP.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.5 违约

blocks.en:
Tab. 5 varies how many windows are read at the fine level.
On QAEgo4D, accuracy rises by 4.8 points from a single level to three refined windows, the setting used everywhere.
A fourth window adds time and lowers the mean. One readout over 128 thumbnails is 3.4 points lower on QAEgo4D at the same mean and time.
Combining the two levels by a plain product instead of the geometric mean lowers QAEgo4D by 4.0 points and the mean by 1.1 ( Tab. 5 ).
For the 54% of QAEgo4D questions whose evidence no thumbnail shows, refinement raises the share with an answer frame within 8 s of the evidence from 45.7% to 54.6% ( Appendix C ).
blocks.zh:
Tab. 5在精细级别读取的窗口数量不同.
在QAEgo4D上,精度从单级上升4.8点,升至3个精制窗口,这是各地使用的设置.
第四个窗口增加了时间,降低了平均值。 一个超过128个缩略图的读出在QAEgo4D上,在同样平均和时间下调3.4分.
用一个平面产物来组合这两个等级,而不是几何平均值将QAEgo4D降低4.0分,平均值为1.1(Tab.5 ).
对于54%的QAEgo4D问题(证据没有缩略图显示),改进后将8s范围内的答案框份额从45.7%提高到54.6%(附录C)。

blocks.en:
Quantile placement is a known rule, so we test whether it suits the readout. Tab. 6 starts from the single-level readout and changes where the 8 answer frames go.
Putting most frames in the top segment (Focus) helps QAEgo4D, where the evidence is brief, but costs 3.5 points on MyEgo and 3.4 on EgoSchema.
Spreading them out helps elsewhere: Spread is best on MyEgo and Strata ties on EgoSchema, but both lose on QAEgo4D.
The quantiles follow the readout: they gather when it is sure and spread when it is not, so they are first or second on every dataset and give the best mean.
blocks.zh:
定量放置是已知的规则,所以我们测试它是否适合读出. Tab. 6从单级读出开始,并更改8个答案框的去向.
将大多数帧放入顶部段(Focus)有助于QAEgo4D,其中证据简短,但在MyEgo和EgoSchema上花费3.5分.
将其推广到其他地方有助于: 扩散在EgoSchema上的MyEgo和Strata的领带上最好,但两者都输在QAEGE4D上.
量子跟随读出:当读出确定时它们会收集,当它不正确时它们会传播,所以它们在每个数据集上是第一或第二,并给出最好的平均值.

blocks.en:
To measure the cost there, every method runs on a Mac with 4-bit weights and a 6 GB memory cap, in one process from recording to answer ( Tab. 8 ).
While the video is recorded, EgoJev adds one thumbnail every 15 s to the VLM’s own cache, which costs 8.2 s per 8 minutes.
At their published settings, BOLT and AKS run a second model on every frame at 1 fps, which costs 28.3 s and 53.8 s.
A.I.R. and FOCUS also run a CLIP or BLIP scorer over many frames, and on the GPU they take 82.9 s and 49.0 s per question, against 26.7 s for EgoJev ( Tab. 1 ).
With 8 answer frames, recording 8 minutes plus one question costs 18.8 s of compute, against 38.7 s for BOLT and 67.4 s for AKS. With 4 answer frames, the answer time halves (5.9 s against 10.7 s). Accuracy also rises to 59.6%, as fewer frames gather near the peak (like Focus in Tab. 6 ). On an iPhone 15 Pro the same pipeline costs 18.3 s for recording and 8.0 s per question, with 5.6 GB of memory at peak.
On 36 to 72 minute recordings, EgoJev keeps an answer frame near the evidence for 44% of questions, against 12% for uniform sampling ( Tab. 14 ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We asked whether a frozen VLM can find the evidence for an egocentric question by itself.
It finds the evidence more often when it chooses among labeled frames and we read its choice from the output distribution.
EgoJev refines this choice from coarse to fine, places a few answer frames at its quantiles, and returns the evidence time with the answer.
With Qwen3.5-4B it is more accurate than recent training-free frame selectors on QAEgo4D and MyEgo, and a single-level version runs on a Mac and an iPhone.
blocks.zh:
我们问,一个被冻结的VLM本身是否能够找到一个自我中心问题的证据。
它更经常地在标签框中选择证据,我们从输出分布中读取它的选择.
EgoJev将这个选择从粗粗细细细细细细地细化,将几个答案框放在它的四分位数上,并用答案返回证据时间.
与 Quen3.5-4B (中文(简体) ). 它比最近QAEgo4D和MyEgo上的免费帧选择器更准确,单层版本运行在Mac和iPhone上.

blocks.en: Like other training-free frame selectors, EgoJev can only find what the VLM recognizes: if the VLM does not recognize the evidence in a thumbnail, the readout cannot point to it. It also needs a VLM that takes interleaved images and returns the full probabilities of its output tokens, which most closed APIs do not.
blocks.zh: 与其他无训练帧选择器一样,EgoJev只能找到VLM识别到的东西:如果VLM无法识别缩略图中的证据,读出不能指向它. 它也需要一个VLM,它可以获取互页图像,并返回其输出符的全部概率,而大多数关闭的API没有.

blocks.en: Appendix F Model notes and label check

blocks.en:
Every localization label ends with “]” so that no label is a prefix of another.
For every model we score label j j as the tokens of “ j j ]”. GLM splits this into the label token and a separate “]” token, so its merged ]</ token is never scored.
GLM-4.1V-9B, released as GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking, writes prose after its default answer prefix, so its answer prefill adds its box token. The localizer prefill is unchanged.
Thinking is turned off for Qwen3.5 and MiniCPM-V-4.5.

每个本地化标签都以“]”结尾,因此没有标签是另一个标签的前缀。
对于每一个模型,我们把标注为jj作为“jj]”的标志。 GLM将这个拆分为标签符和一个单独的“]”符符,因此其合并的</符符符永远不会得分.
GLM-4.1V-9B,作为GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking发行,在其默认的答案前缀后写作旁白,因此其答案前填充增加了其框符. 本地化器预填未变.
思潮为Quen3.5和MiniCPM-V-4.5关机.

blocks.en:
The test shifts the labels by N / 2 N/2 and correlates the new coarse readout with the original one, matched once by label number and once by image.
The check fires when the match by number is higher. It then reads the coarse readout once more with the labels in reverse order and combines the two by their geometric mean.
Because the check reads no answers, all results use the full test sets.
Answer letters follow the option format of each dataset, “(A” on QAEgo4D and “A” otherwise, for every method. For models that also offer the other form, we score whichever form has more total probability.
blocks.zh:
测试以 N / 2 N/2 调换标签, 并将新的粗读值与原标签值联系起来, 用标签编号和图像匹配一次。
当比对数更高时,检查会点火. 然后它再用反序的标签读粗读出来一次,用它们的几何平均值将两者结合.
因为检查没有读到答案,所以所有结果都使用完整的测试集.
回答字母遵循每个数据集的选项格式,“A”在QAEgo4D上,“A”在其它情况下,对每一种方法。 对于同样提供另一种形态的模型,我们得分,无论哪种形态的概率更高。

A wearable records far longer than one QAEgo4D clip.
To test this, each of 100 QAEgo4D questions is asked about its own video joined with five other test videos, which gives recordings of 36 to 72 minutes (49 on average).
EgoJev keeps N = 32 N=32 thumbnails, so its time per question stays the same (5.95 s against 5.82 s of GPU time, without decoding).
It remains the most accurate, and it keeps an answer frame near the evidence almost four times as often as uniform sampling ( Tab. 13 ).

EgoJev保留了N = 32 N = 32缩略图,因此每个问题的时间保持不变(5.95s对5.82s的GPU时间,没有解码).
它仍然是最准确的,在证据附近保持了一个几乎是统一抽样的四倍的答案框架(Tab.13)。

blocks.en:
The localization readout scores every label sequence.
Scoring them one by one takes 627 ms per question at 4.39 GB peak, batching the labels takes 562 ms at 5.38 GB, and one pass with an fp32 cache state takes 304 ms at 5.58 GB.
One pass with a bf16 cache state takes 272 ms at 4.64 GB and picks the same top segment as scoring one by one on 50 of 50 questions.
The iPhone (iPhone 15 Pro, 8 GB, iOS 26.6) uses this last variant, and the Mac runs in Tab. 8 use the fp32 state.
The iPhone caps answer frames at 192 visual tokens.
